title: Add reservation form with WhatsApp integration and floating support button

requirements.text: Change hero section text colors in frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx to match the gold icon color (#D4AF37). Update the location text, phone number text, and hours text in the contact cards to use the same gold color as the icons for visual consistency.

quotes: change text color into icon color

acceptanceCriteria: Location text color matches the gold icon color (#D4AF37)
Phone number text color matches the gold icon color (#D4AF37)
Hours text color matches the gold icon color (#D4AF37)
All text remains clearly readable against the card backgrounds

requirements.text: Create a new ReservationSection component (frontend/src/components/ReservationSection.tsx) with a section titled 'Reserve Your Table'. Include a professional booking form with the following required fields: Full Name (text input, required), Mobile Number (text input, required), Email Address (text input, optional), Number of Guests (dropdown 1-20, required), Reservation Date (date picker, required), Reservation Time (time picker, required), Occasion (dropdown with options: Birthday, Anniversary, Casual Visit, Party, Other; required), and Special Request (textarea, optional). Use elegant styling consistent with the restaurant's charcoal and gold theme.

quotes: Include a professional booking form with the following required fields

acceptanceCriteria: Section displays 'Reserve Your Table' as the heading
Form includes all specified fields with proper input types
Required fields are clearly marked
Number of Guests dropdown contains options 1-20
Occasion dropdown contains exactly: Birthday, Anniversary, Casual Visit, Party, Other
Date and time pickers are functional
Form styling matches the restaurant's professional theme with charcoal and gold colors

requirements.text: Add a bold red 'Reserve Now' button with a pointing emoji (👉) to the reservation form in ReservationSection component. Implement form validation that checks all required fields (Full Name, Mobile Number, Number of Guests, Reservation Date, Reservation Time, Occasion) are filled before submission. Display clear error messages for any missing required fields.

quotes: Add a bold red button: 👉 "Reserve Now"
The form should validate required fields

acceptanceCriteria: Button displays '👉 Reserve Now' text
Button uses bold red styling
Form validates all required fields on button click
Error messages display for missing required fields
Form cannot submit if validation fails

requirements.text:
Implement WhatsApp integration in the ReservationSection component. When the 'Reserve Now' button is clicked and form validation passes, generate a pre-filled WhatsApp message with all customer details formatted as: 'Hello Perfetto Pizza Plus,

New Table Reservation Request:

Name: [Customer Name]
Mobile: [Customer Number]
Email: [Customer Email]
Guests: [Number of Guests]
Date: [Selected Date]
Time: [Selected Time]
Occasion: [Selected Occasion]
Special Request: [Message]

Please confirm my reservation. Thank you.' Open WhatsApp Web or WhatsApp app with this pre-filled message directed to the phone number +919797957878 using the WhatsApp API URL format (https://wa.me/919797957878?text=).

quotes: All form details must automatically open in WhatsApp
The message must be sent directly to the owner's mobile number: +919797957878
The WhatsApp message must be pre-filled with all customer details

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Reserve Now' with valid form data opens WhatsApp
WhatsApp message is pre-filled with the exact format specified
All form field values are correctly inserted into the message template
WhatsApp link targets the phone number +919797957878
Date and time values are formatted in a user-friendly readable format
Message text is properly URL-encoded for WhatsApp API

requirements.text: Create a FloatingWhatsAppButton component (frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsAppButton.tsx) that displays a floating button fixed at the bottom-right corner of the website with the text 'Chat With Us on WhatsApp'. When clicked, it should open a direct WhatsApp chat with the phone number +919797957878 using the WhatsApp API URL (https://wa.me/919797957878). Style the button with green WhatsApp brand colors, appropriate spacing from edges (e.g., 24px), a WhatsApp icon, subtle shadow, and ensure it remains visible and accessible on mobile devices.

quotes: Also add a floating WhatsApp button at the bottom-right corner of the website
When clicked, it should open direct WhatsApp chat with the same owner number: +919797957878

acceptanceCriteria: Button is fixed at bottom-right corner of viewport
Button displays 'Chat With Us on WhatsApp' text
Button includes a WhatsApp icon
Clicking button opens WhatsApp chat with +919797957878
Button uses green WhatsApp brand colors (#25D366 or similar)
Button remains visible when scrolling
Button is properly positioned on mobile devices
Button has appropriate hover and focus states

requirements.text: Add the ReservationSection component to the main App component (frontend/src/App.tsx) after the MenuSection and before the ExtraCharges component. Also add the FloatingWhatsAppButton component at the end of the App component so it appears globally across all sections.
acceptanceCriteria: ReservationSection renders between MenuSection and ExtraCharges
FloatingWhatsAppButton renders and remains visible globally
Page layout remains properly structured with all sections
No layout or spacing issues introduced

constraints: Use the existing charcoal and gold color theme from frontend/tailwind.config.js and frontend/index.css
Maintain consistent styling with existing components (Hero, BusinessDetails, MenuSection)
Ensure the red 'Reserve Now' button stands out while remaining professional
WhatsApp integration must use the WhatsApp API URL format (https://wa.me/) and not require any backend services
The floating WhatsApp button must not obstruct important content or interfere with page scrolling
nonGoals: Backend storage or processing of reservation data
